scripts.test: npm run test:desktop && npm run test --workspaces
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p api/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.package: npm run build && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --linux AppImage deb --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:x64: npm run build && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never -c.directories.output=release/mac-x64
scripts.package:mac:arm64: npm run build && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never -c.directories.output=release/mac-arm64
scripts.demo:record: npm run build && node desktop/scripts/run-e2e.mjs --config playwright.demo.config.ts
scripts.lint:backend: eslint api desktop e2e electron.vite.config.mts playwright.config.ts
scripts.typecheck:backend: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p api/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.test:backend:coverage: npm run test:desktop && npm run test:coverage --workspace api
